title: Win without the best hand
hook: You don't need the best hand. You need them to believe you have it.
caption:

headline: WIN
WITHOUT
THE HAND.

scenes.say: You don't need the best hand. You need them to believe you have it.
Fold equity: the value of your opponent giving up before the cards are shown.
scenes.show: The value of them giving up.

scenes.say: Your hand wins only {equity} when called. You bet {bet} into {pot}.
scenes.note: Computed: EV = fold% × pot + (1 − fold%) × (equity × (pot + 2·bet) − bet)

scenes.say: If they never fold, the bet loses {ev_no_fold}.
They only need to fold {breakeven_fold} of the time to break even. If they fold {fold_ex}, you make {ev_ex}.
Pressure is an asset. But only against someone who can actually fold.

takeaway: Pressure is an asset. But only against someone who can actually fold.
